principle.title: Preserve the caller contract when implementing a small change
principle.condition: When implementing an API from a behavior contract and existing callers
principle.action: Keep names, return shapes and caller-owned inputs stable. Preserve meaningful zero, false, empty and null values. Prefer standard-library operations with the required semantics. Check both ordinary and edge inputs before returning complete source files.
principle.reason: Independent JSON roundtrip and array sorting exercises failed when values were filtered or caller inputs were mutated; standard-library repairs passed the same assertions.
